title: DeFi Stablecoin Yield Scanner (DefiLlama)
description: Scans every DeFi lending/LP pool tracked by DefiLlama and returns stablecoin yields filtered by TVL, APY, chain and impermanent-loss risk. Output includes direct pool links.

minApy.title: Minimum APY (%)
minApy.description: Pools below this APY are dropped. Set 0 to see everything.

stablecoinOnly.title: Stablecoin pools only
stablecoinOnly.description: When enabled, only pools whose symbol is a stablecoin pair (USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS...) are returned.

excludeIl.title: Exclude impermanent-loss pools
excludeIl.description: When enabled, AMM pools exposed to impermanent loss are filtered out. Keep enabled for single-sided lending yields.

topN.title: Max results
topN.description: Maximum number of pools written to the dataset, sorted by APY descending.
